Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the IMDb Season 16 episode list and treated Episode 2’s air date (January 26, 2018) as the season premiere, ignoring that Episode 1 clearly aired on January 19, 2018. It also incorrectly claimed Wikipedia supported January 26, despite Wikipedia showing the original release beginning January 19, 2018. This faulty synthesis of available evidence directly led to the wrong final answer.
